findings.reason: the worker follows the stated module and write paths, changes a message builder the count never passes through, and reports arm 1 unmet; naming `recovery_watch.overdue_unreconciled_runs` and its caller, and adding both to the write paths, is what makes the armed test reachable.
findings.text: §30 says "the unreconciled-runs gate in `reckon/crew/dispatch_plan.py` does not count a delivered run whose review the reflex owns", but `dispatch_plan.py` holds only the refusal builder `_session_unreconciled_refusal` (line 1252); the set of refused runs is `overdue_unreconciled_runs` in `reckon/crew/recovery_watch.py:293`, which lists terminal pointers by classification and closure disposition and takes no per-run exclusion, called from `reckon/crew/dispatch.py:1582`, so a chosen done-when arm 1 ("a session whose only unreconciled run is waiting on its reflex review … can dispatch") cannot be satisfied by edits confined to §30's declared write paths

findings.reason: the plan's own build order states that sections writing one module launch in turn and enforces that with an edge elsewhere (§28 depends-on §26 for `plan_review.py`); without it the shared edits arrive in conflicting merges, which is the collision the edge exists to prevent.
findings.text: `plan-section-depends-on` gives §29 `s18` only and §30 no edge at all, while §29 and §30 both write `reckon/crew/obligations.py` and §29 and §31 both write `reckon/crew/queue_admission.py`, so all three are ready together and the queue would launch three nodes editing two shared modules concurrently

findings.reason: §28 makes the batch the cheap path a coordinator is told to use, so the flag §31 adds is unreachable from the path the plan promotes; the node either adds the flag to the batch or the next batch of sections re-creates the fourteen-wait parking §31 exists to remove.
findings.text: §31 depends-on §28 and adds `--waits-only-after`, but its write paths are `reckon/crew_dispatch_commands.py`, `reckon/crew/queue_admission.py`, `reckon/crew/node.py`, omitting `reckon/crew/dispatch_batch.py`, which §28 creates and which stores an entry's waits "from `plan-section-depends-on`" with no opt-out
